description: Розклад руху міського електричного та автомобільного транспорту is a dataset listed in data.gov.ua, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Великокучурівська сільська рада Чернівецької області. The set contains data on public transport flights (resource trips); schedule of departure and arrival of transport to and from stops (stopTimes resource); options for weekly schedules of public transport (resource calendar); list of exceptions to weekly schedules (resource calendarDates). Coverage: Великокучурівська сільська рада Чернівецької області. The portal shows the English title as "Schedule of urban electric and road transport" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Великокучурівська сільська рада Чернівецької області. Its keywords include тролейбус, прибуття, перевізники, час, маршрут, відбуття. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-08-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ua.
